title: TestSeekBackBeforeTheResumePoint keeps a 20 s bound that is under ten times a right build under load
notes: queue_integration_test.go (`time.Since(began) > 20*time.Second`, listed in test/timing-bounds.txt as a hang bound of 'a few seconds'). On a right build with one contended CPU (taskset -c 0 plus 4 busy loops) the seek took 4.27 s, so the bound is about 4.7x. docs/testing.md says a bound closer than ten times a right build is a bar.
